items.name: Everyday Mung and Lauki Dal
steps: Rinse the split mung dal and soak it for 25 minutes; drain well.
Simmer the pulse with turmeric and water until it begins to soften.
Add the bottle gourd, diced and continue cooking until both pulse and vegetables are tender.
Warm the ghee, bloom the cumin, coriander, and ginger, then fold the tempering into the pot with rock salt.
Simmer uncovered for five minutes, stir to an even consistency, and serve warm.
items.guidance: Everyday Mung and Lauki Dal pairs a thoroughly cooked pulse with vegetables for an everyday one-bowl main. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.

items.name: Everyday Carrot Pea Pulao
steps: Rinse the white basmati rice until the draining water is mostly clear; soak for 15 minutes and drain.
Warm the ghee in a heavy pot and bloom the cumin.
Add the carrot, diced, green peas, indian bay leaf and drained grain; stir for one minute.
Pour in the water and add the rock salt; cover and cook on low heat until the grain is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest off the heat for eight minutes, then lift the grains gently and serve warm.

Add the spinach, chopped, coriander seeds and drained grain; stir for one minute.
Pour in the water and add the rock salt; cover and cook on low heat until the grain is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest off the heat for eight minutes, then lift the grains gently and serve warm.
items.guidance: Everyday Spinach Rice is a lightly seasoned one-pot grain dish intended for a warm midday meal. Vata: serve warm, cook until tender, and add a little ghee if the dish feels dry. Pitta: moderate chilies and sharp sourness, favoring coriander or fennel. Kapha: keep the portion light, reduce added fat, and favor ginger or black pepper.
